abstract: In non-seminomatous testicular tumor, 60% of failures are seen within the first three months after diagnosis. The most common site of metastasis is the lung. Occasionally, bone, liver and brain metastases are seen. In this series of 33 cases, the definitively treated Stage I patients are alive and well for an average of 6.3 years (12 patients); one was lost to follow-up. The 20 more advanced patients have not done well--16 are dead from disease with an average survival of 17 months, 3 are alive with disease for an average of two years, and one was lost to follow-up. In Stages II and III, the best results were obtained with an aggressive multimodality approach of surgery, postoperative irradiation and chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍では、治療失敗の60%が診断後3か月以内に認められる。最も多い転移部位は肺であり、時に骨、肝臓、脳に転移がみられる。本研究の33例のうち、確定治療を受けた病期I症例12例は平均6.3年にわたり生存し無病で経過している(1例はフォローアップ不能となった)。進行例20例は予後不良で、16例は平均17か月で原病死し、3例は平均2年間病勢を伴って生存、1例はフォローアップ不能となった。病期IIおよびIIIでは、手術、術後放射線療法、化学療法を組み合わせた積極的な集学的治療で最良の成績が得られた。
